type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {f : Polynomial ℤ} {P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ}
  {r : σ → ℕ} {A B β : ℝ} {s : ℕ},
  (∀ (i : ℕ), |↑(f.coeff i)| ≤ A) →
    (∀ (k : σ), degreeOf k P ≤ r k) →
      (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), |↑(P.coeff d)| ≤ B) →
        ∑ k : σ, r k ≤ s →
          2 ^ s ≤ β →
            (1 + A) ^ s ≤ β → ∀ (j : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : ℕ), |(Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) P) %ₘ f).coeff i| ≤ ↑⌊B * β ^ 3⌋₊
what: Bounds integer remainder coefficients of diagonal Hasse derivatives by the natural floor of B times beta cubed under common exponential bounds.
how: Use abs_coeff_diag_hasseDeriv_modByMonic_le_aux, bound box cardinality by a power of two, handle zero-degree/nonmonic divisors and convert with Int.le_floor.
hypotheses: Finite variables; total degree bound, divisor/input coefficient bounds and common growth-factor bounds. The exact captured parameters and existing ambient types are printed; no additional project-defined structure is captured.
caller_summary: 1 explicit source caller declarations, all in MainLemma.lean; 1 direct original value consumers. Exact separate lists retained. Entire MainLemma module proof bodies replay successfully with fresh target name.
mathlib_api_audit: Derive beta>=1 from the powers-of-two bound. Bound the box product by 2^(sum r), and invoke the precise preceding coefficient estimate, absorbing the box, Hasse and remainder-elimination factors into beta. Treat divisor natural degree zero separately: monic constant is1 and has zero remainder, while nonmonic modByMonic returns the input and the zero-divisor estimate applies. Finish with Int.natCast_floor_eq_floor and Int.le_floor. The sole rpow-bound existence caller compares this floor with floor(B^c) before pigeonholing; no monicity premise is needed by this bound itself.
